attributes.board_name: Massachusetts Board of Registration in Nursing

rules.alternatives: All APRNs must maintain current certification through a Board-approved national certifying organization to keep Board authorization to practice; a lapse ends authorization.
rules.notes: No APRN-specific hours on the Board CE page. The RN license still needs 15 contact hours within the 2 years before renewal (on the birthday in even years; none for the first renewal). The Board also lists Domestic and Sexual Violence Training (Chapter 260) without hours.
